items.label: Stylized
items.text: Combat should be Stylized: Fights will be cool and over-the-top akin to RWBY and Metal Gear Solid: The Twin Snakes. Impossible movement and reaction speed, sustained exchanges, environmental destruction. Fights should be described like a dance. Fights escalate through set pieces. Logic must be bent to make things cool.

items.label: Cinematic
items.text: Combat should be Cinematic: Fights are staged for spectacle. Exchanges run long, choreography prioritizes clarity and escalation, and the environment is used deliberately.

items.label: Brutal
items.text: Combat should be Brutal: Fights are desperate and graceless. Combatants grapple, bite, use terrain and improvised weapons, and abandon technique under pressure.

items.label: Realistic
items.text: Combat should be Realistic: Fights are short, ugly, and decided quickly. Technique is limited by fatigue, fear, and injury; exchanges last seconds.
